reuse.why: Builds one linkBankSyncAccount that all six providers (including Fintegra) delegate to, and extracts clearBankLink so the replace path and unlinkAccount share the same unlink state.

duplication.why: Removes five copies of the link sequence; the only new copy is downloadFintegraTransactions, a near-verbatim clone of the Akahu download following the tree's per-provider pattern.

placement.why: Link rules sit in the shared link function in accounts/app.ts, the download in sync.ts, URL in server-config, types in types/models, and the client provider tables are extended where the type maps require.

scope.why: Everything serves the five steps; the desktop-client edits are the minimum the exhaustive provider records demand, plus a release note per repo convention.

maintainability.why: Clear, parameterised helper with provider wrappers that pass only their data; minor wart is the upgrading account being read twice (closed check, then full row).

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every provider link, including Fintegra, goes through linkBankSyncAccount; replace-unlink uses clearBankLink shared with unlinkAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: The Fintegra download copy is an open clone of downloadAkahuTransactions, not reshaped; the link logic was genuinely shared.

abstraction_drift.where: After the refactor, linkBankSyncAccount only gains replaceExistingLink; the duplicate-link and closed-account checks apply to every provider, and all link call sites use the helper.
